scene.heading: SCENE 01 - EXT. MAHAWEWA CANAL - DAWN - 1 MINUTE
scene.title: The canal discovery
script: Heavy rain. Aruni walks beside a paddy field carrying a small medical bag.
She notices something caught near the canal gate: a body. It is Nimal.
She does not scream. She kneels and touches his hand.
Inside his fist is a small metal key marked C-17.
A distant bus horn mixes with the rain.
scene.axis: The field-edge path runs screen left to right toward the gate. Nimal lies at the near bank against the gate, head on the bank at screen right and feet toward the water at screen left. people.name: Nimal
people.appearance: Average height, broad-shouldered and solidly built, with warm medium-brown skin. Broad cheekbones and a softly squared chin shared with Aruni; wider face, thick brows, slightly rounded nose and a neat black moustache. Short, dense, wavy black hair with a low side part.
people.outfit: Faded rust-brown cotton shirt, dark brown trousers, a worn black belt and dark rubber-soled sandals.
people.hair: Short, dense, wavy black hair with a low side part.
people.scene_condition: Lies still beside the canal gate, eyes closed, one fist closed around a small metal key. Shirt sleeves rolled to the forearms; clothes rain-soaked, with darkened hems and flattened wet hair.

people.name: Aruni
people.appearance: Average height with a compact, sturdy build and warm medium-brown skin. Oval face, broad cheekbones, straight dark brows and large, steady dark eyes. Thick black hair, centre-parted and secured in a low bun. Aruni and Nimal share broad cheekbones and a softly squared chin.
people.outfit: White short-sleeved nurse's uniform dress with a neat collar, below-knee hem and white waist belt; plain white low-heeled closed shoes.
people.hair: Thick black hair centre-parted and secured in a low bun.
people.accessories: Small silver ear studs and a small medical bag.
people.scene_condition: Uniform and hair wet from heavy rain; kneels beside the canal gate and touches Nimal's hand.

place.name: Mahawewa Canal
place.look: Exterior village irrigation canal at dawn in heavy rain. A narrow channel of opaque brown water runs between red-earth banks, with a muddy footpath beside green paddy and a weathered concrete sluice structure. Wet grasses edge the channel; exposed concrete is stained dark with damp and algae. Diffuse grey dawn light, muted earthy reds and faint amber along the horizon.

spots.name: paddy field
spots.look: A low, waterlogged paddy plot beside the canal footpath, with short green rice rows, red-brown earthen bunds and rain-dimpled standing water.

spots.name: canal gate
spots.look: A small rust-brown steel sluice gate in a stained concrete throat, with a vertical lifting spindle, wet ledges and grass caught along the waterline.

props.name: phone
props.details: Palm-sized black smartphone with a plain dark protective case, slightly scuffed corners and a clear glass touchscreen with a simple call interface.

props.name: medical bag
props.details: Small rectangular navy medical bag in wipe-clean coated fabric, with black piping, two short carrying handles, a zippered top and lightly scuffed lower corners.
